_about: Settings for the animated pool water in the front-page hero. Change a number, save, and redeploy. Fields starting with _ are notes and are not read by the code. The parameter names match the water tuner, so values copied from it fit here. Note: the hero background before the animation starts is a still picture of the first frame (poster-*.avif); after big changes it no longer matches perfectly until it is made again.

camera._about: The virtual camera that looks down at the pool. It decides the perspective of the whole scene.

_help.camHeight: How high above the water the camera hangs, in metres. Higher = the pool looks further away.
_help.fov: Field of view in degrees. Bigger = wider, more fish-eye; smaller = more zoomed in.
_help.pitch: How much the camera tilts away from looking straight down, in degrees. 0 = straight down.
_help.roll: Sideways tilt of the camera, in degrees.
_help.yaw: Turns the camera around the vertical axis, in degrees.

waves._about: The surface waves. Twelve small waves of different sizes are added together; they bend the light that reaches the pool floor.

_help.amp: Wave height in metres. Bigger = rougher water and stronger light patterns.
_help.speed: How fast the waves move. 1 = physically correct speed for their size; lower = calmer.
_help.tile: Size in metres of the area the wave pattern covers before it repeats. Bigger = longer, softer waves.

waveGroups._about: The twelve waves are split into three groups: big, middle, and small. Each group slowly gets stronger and weaker on its own (a smooth random drift), so the water never repeats exactly.

_help.bigMix: Overall share of the big waves (0 = off, 1 = full).
_help.midMix: Overall share of the middle waves.
_help.smallMix: Overall share of the small waves.
_help.bigGain: How much the big waves drift stronger and weaker over time (0 = steady).
_help.midGain: Same drift for the middle waves.
_help.smallGain: Same drift for the small waves.
_help.bigRate: How quickly the big waves drift, in cycles per second. Smaller = slower changes.
_help.midRate: Drift speed of the middle waves.
_help.smallRate: Drift speed of the small waves.

sunAndSky._about: Where the sun is and how the sky and sun light the water.

_help.sunElev: Sun height above the horizon, in degrees. 90 = straight overhead.
_help.sunAz: Sun direction around the pool, in degrees.
_help.sunDiffuse: Plain sunlight on the pool floor (without the moving light patterns).
_help.ambient: Soft base light everywhere, so shadows never go black.
_help.sky: How much the sky reflects in the water surface, mostly at flat viewing angles.
_help.sparkle: Strength of the bright sun glints on the wave tops.
_help.glintElev: Moves the glints up or down on screen, in degrees, without moving the sun itself.
_help.glintAz: Moves the glints sideways, in degrees. Used to keep them away from the hero text.

caustics._about: Caustics are the bright, moving lines of light on the pool floor, made by the waves focusing sunlight.

_help.blur: Softness of the light lines. Higher = blurrier.
_help.contrast: Below 1 the lines look softer and wider; above 1 they look sharper and thinner.
_help.mix2: Blends in a second, rotated copy of the pattern so it does not look like a repeating tile (0 = off).
_help.variation: Makes some areas of the floor brighter and others dimmer (0 = even everywhere).
_help.varScale: Size of those bright and dim areas. Smaller = bigger areas.
_help.breakup: Breaks the light lines into pieces instead of long unbroken threads (0 = off).
_help.breakScale: Size of the pieces. Bigger = smaller pieces.

poolFloor._about: The pool bottom: its depth and the tiles on it.

_help.depth: Water depth in metres. Deeper = more blue and the light lines spread out more.
_help.tileStr: How visible the tiles are (0 = plain floor).
_help.grout: Width of the lines between tiles, in metres.
_help.tileVar: Small colour differences from tile to tile, so they do not look perfect.
_help.tileAngle: Direction of the tile rows, in degrees (lined up with the diving board).
_help.tileFog: How fast the tiles fade out with distance.
_help.tileBlur: How much the tiles blur with distance.

waterColor._about: The colour of the water itself.

_help.absorb: How much the water swallows light per metre (red goes first, so deeper looks bluer).
_help.scatter: Light bouncing around inside the water, giving it its turquoise haze.
_help.green: Shifts the water colour from blue (-1) towards green (+1).
_help.sat: Colour saturation of the final picture (1 = normal, lower = greyer).

diverShadow._about: The shadow of the diver and the diving board on the pool floor.

_help.castX: Shadow offset sideways, as a share of the picture width.
_help.castY: Shadow offset up or down, as a share of the picture height.
_help.castWobble: How much the waves bend the shadow.

screenLight._about: Finishing light over the whole picture, like a photographer's grading.

_help.lightStr: Strength of a soft light gradient across the picture (0 = off).
_help.lightAngle: Direction the gradient comes from, in degrees.
_help.lightSoft: How wide and soft the gradient is.
_help.darken: Makes the whole picture a little darker.

_help.resScale: Render resolution compared with the screen (0.5 = half). Lower = lighter for the graphics card, slightly softer picture.
